baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal link joins never wishing to what their hands have advanced and to divine knowledge of wrongdoers.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inward wish is blocked by an outward record already dispatched ahead of its makers. The hands make responsibility embodied rather than abstract, while knowing and withheld right make the record both discoverable and morally charged.

activation_trace.role: Heart-formed wishing supplies the response being negated; the causal clause makes its blockage diagnostic.
Forward precedence turns prior conduct into a dispatch that already occupies the space ahead.
The attribution of action and offense to both hands converts an inner reluctance into embodied evidence.
Knowledge as disclosure prevents the hand-made record from remaining concealed behind a verbal posture.
Withholding or confinement from a right gives the advanced deeds a concrete moral mechanism rather than a generic label.

changed_reading.before: They simply do not want the unnamed object, perhaps from fear.
changed_reading.after: Their inability to wish is a symptom produced by an embodied record that has gone ahead of them and cannot be hidden from the Knower.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated wishing is immediately measured against what the hands previously advanced.
baseline_models.mechanism: Several wishing branches turn the sentence into an assay: an imagined or even fabricated avowal is weighed and matched against conduct. The hand-to-hand image makes the comparison transactional, so the utterance fails because no equivalent deed can settle it.

activation_trace.role: A standard of weight makes wishing the verbal item placed on a scale against prior conduct.
Matching one act with another supplies the calibration between claim and embodied performance.
Invented wishing keeps open the possibility that the absent utterance would otherwise be a convenient fiction.
Immediate hand-to-hand settlement gives the claim test an exchange-like demand for present equivalence.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports the absence of a private desire.
changed_reading.after: The verse reports a failed calibration: an avowal cannot be coined, weighed, or matched into credibility because the hands supply the counterweight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Never, the latent death-image in wishing, forward movement, and what lies before the hands form a temporal-spatial cluster.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents remain fixed while their acts have moved into the anterior future. The wished endpoint carries a latent image of decreed death, so permanence is not an empty duration: it is prolonged non-movement toward an endpoint whose approach has already been furnished by their deeds.

activation_trace.role: Decreed death gives the otherwise unresolved object of wishing a latent terminal horizon without yet fixing it exclusively.
Unbounded duration stretches the refusal across time rather than limiting it to one moment.
Remaining without departure converts long duration into positional stasis.
Advancing and preceding sends the deeds into the space that the agents themselves will enter later.
The region before the hands spatializes the future as already occupied by the record.

changed_reading.before: Never is only an emphatic temporal adverb.
changed_reading.after: Never depicts a frozen agent behind a mobile record: the person does not advance toward the endpoint, but the deeds have already gone there.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Hands, deliberate advancement, and wrongdoing as putting or withholding something where it does not belong.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hands can signify power, gift, and possession as well as bodily organs. Their prior advancement therefore audits how entrusted capacity was directed: force, benefit, and property were intentionally put out of place or held away from a right.

activation_trace.role: The hand as strength expands the record from discrete acts to the deployment of capacity.
The hand as bestowed benefit makes received advantage part of what can be advanced well or badly.
The possessing hand brings property and control inside the field of responsibility.
Directed intention prevents the advancement from being read as accidental drift.
Putting something in the wrong time or place supplies the governing failure of allocation.

changed_reading.before: What the hands advanced is a generic list of bad deeds.
changed_reading.after: What the hands advanced is an allocation history: strength, gifts, and holdings intentionally placed or withheld in ways that made the later wish untenable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context activates a kinetic contrast. A cosmos in running or swimming glorification and purification surrounds a subject who remains fixed while only the hand-made record moves forward; wrongdoing appears as a local jam or misplacement within that larger motion.

activation_trace.role: Running and swimming supply the context's pervasive directed motion, against which the focus refusal can register as stasis.
Clinging heavily to the ground supplies the counter-image of immobility within the heaven-earth field.
Purification gives the cosmic movement a transformative direction, sharpening the focus record's failure to be cleared.
Non-departure anchors the focus side of the moving-versus-stuck contrast.
The deeds' forward movement makes the record mobile even while its makers remain fixed.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a present-tense whole-cosmos action before narrowing to the focus refusal.
In the focus sentence, permanent non-wishing is followed by a verb of prior advancement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic motion, purification, ground-clinging, non-departure, and advancement; I infer a normative motion-versus-jam relation. A live alternative is that the opening action is purely liturgical and contributes no kinetic contrast.

changed_reading.before: The refusal is an isolated psychological fact.
changed_reading.after: The refusal can be heard as self-produced stasis inside a moving, purifying order: the deeds travel, but their makers cannot move into the truth of their claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of reciting, purifying, teaching, and binding in writing activates the recitation branch inside wishing. A line uttered or read is expected to continue into purified action; the focus refusal marks a broken transmission from voiced text and learned content into the hands.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence makes recitation a continuation that should carry words onward into life.
Purification and rectification supply the expected transformation between reception and action.
Teaching as disclosure links imparted knowledge to the Knower named in the focus.
Writing as binding determination gives the recited material a claim on conduct rather than leaving it informational.
The wishing root's reading or recitation image allows the negated wish to register as a line that cannot be truthfully performed.
The hands test whether recited and taught material continued into embodied action.

structural_cues: The four linked actions in 62:2 move from voiced signs through purification and teaching to the Book.
The focus gives the hand-made record, not verbal possession, as the reason for refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, purification, teaching, binding writing, the wishing root's recitation branch, and hands-as-action; I infer a word-to-body transmission. The live alternative is that the recitation branch is only a distant lexical resonance and the context concerns instruction without this bodily arrow.

changed_reading.before: Not wishing is merely an unspoken feeling.
changed_reading.after: Not wishing exposes a missing embodied continuation: the decisive line cannot be recited into truth because learned text stopped before reaching the hands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies three vectors: later people catch up, deeds advance ahead, and a fleeing person is met by death. These motions make the focus refusal one unstable interval in a pursuit geometry, not a stable preference protected by distance.

activation_trace.role: A later party reaching what is ahead establishes catch-up as an early contextual motion.
Loss of life identifies the endpoint that the adjacent challenge makes latent in the focus wish.
Flight gives the non-wish a bodily direction away from the named endpoint.
Two approaching sides meeting reverses the imagined benefit of flight: the endpoint travels into encounter.
The deeds are the third moving party, already preceding the agents who made them.
Enduring duration makes evasion recur without converting it into escape.

structural_cues: Catch-up appears before the focus, while flight and meeting appear immediately after it.
The focus itself places an advancing record between those two contextual movements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies catch-up, forward deeds, flight, encounter, and duration; I align them as interacting trajectories. A live alternative keeps the catch-up in 62:3 as social inclusion only and limits the race mechanism to 62:7-8.

changed_reading.before: They can indefinitely preserve distance from what they do not wish for.
changed_reading.after: Their record has already passed them and the endpoint approaches from the direction of flight; never names repeated refusal, not successful distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding gift vocabulary revises the hand record from a ledger only of offenses into an accounting of received surplus and capacity. A bestowed advantage enters the hand, and wrongdoing can consist in deliberately placing it wrongly or withholding the right it enabled.

activation_trace.role: Gift and benefaction supply the positive resource whose later handling can create liability.
The act of giving establishes a transfer into human custody before the focus audits what hands send onward.
The hand as benefit lets received grace and human agency occupy the same bodily sign.
Possession identifies custody as the point at which gift becomes accountable use.
Withholding a right explains how a received advantage can become an incriminating omission.

structural_cues: 62:4 repeats divine bounty and giving shortly before the hand-made record in 62:7.
The focus causal clause permits omissions and withheld use, not only overt acts, to explain the refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, giving, hand-as-benefit, possession, and withholding; I infer a fiduciary arrow from reception to accountable circulation. A live alternative reads the bounty only as divine generosity and the hand record only as committed offenses.

changed_reading.before: The hands are guilty only for harmful things they actively did.
changed_reading.after: The hands are also answerable for what grace enabled them to give, protect, or circulate but they misallocated or withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carrying parable creates a body-map for the focus. Revealing writing can remain an external load borne on a back instead of becoming an entrusted burden enacted by the hands; wrongdoing is the topological error of keeping knowledge in the wrong bodily place.

activation_trace.role: Repeated carrying as bearing a trust makes the load an obligation, not merely transported weight.
The book that reveals writing supplies meaningful content that can still remain externally carried.
Misplacing a thing gives the failed carrying a spatial diagnosis: knowledge has not reached its proper operative site.
Hands as emphatic agents provide the bodily destination where carried knowledge would become conduct.
Disclosure distinguishes genuine knowing from merely having revealed material on one's back.

structural_cues: 62:5 repeats the carrying construction three times and closes with the same wrongdoing designation used in the focus.
62:7 shifts bodily attention from the bearer and its load to the hands and their prior action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entrusted carrying, revealing books, misplacement, hands-as-action, and knowing; I infer transfer from external load to operative hand as the missing step. A live alternative treats the parable as a general rebuke for noncompliance without this body-map.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns deeds independently of the preceding image of carried books.
changed_reading.after: The focus tests whether revelation migrated from carried load into hand-shaped conduct; the refusal exposes knowledge left on the back rather than lived through the hands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate challenge turns wishing into a costly proof of an exclusive proximity claim. Uncertain assertion is set against alliance without interval, while truth requires word to be realized in deed; the focus is the assay result, with the hands supplying the failed proof.

activation_trace.role: Assertion without certainty identifies the antecedent posture that the death-wish challenge tests.
Proximity without a separating gap makes the claimed relation especially exposed to a test involving return to God.
The commanded heart-imaged wish supplies the explicit performance whose non-occurrence the focus announces.
Departure of life fixes the challenge's object and gives the avowal an irreversible cost.
Truth as fulfilling speech through action establishes deed-equivalence as the condition of passing the test.
Act-for-act matching turns the commanded wish into a calibration rather than a request for information.
The hands provide the embodied result against which the verbal claim is measured.

structural_cues: 62:6 has an explicit conditional structure: exclusive claim, commanded wish for death, and a truth condition.
62:7 answers the command with permanent non-performance and gives prior hand action as its cause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertain claiming, immediate proximity, commanded death-wishing, deed-realized truth, and the hand record; I infer that the command functions as a costly proof. A live alternative treats it as exposure by rhetoric rather than a general claim-action assay.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that claimants happen to fear death.
changed_reading.after: The verse publishes the result of a costly proof: the exclusive closeness claim cannot produce its required performance because embodied history contradicts it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus return sequence turns the advanced deeds into a record that comes back as report. Concealed and present domains collapse before the Knower, and intentional work is narrated to its makers; sending deeds away never transfers ownership of them.

activation_trace.role: Return to the proper destination reverses the apparent one-way dispatch of the focus deeds.
Knowledge as disclosure links the return directly to the focus declaration of the Knower.
Concealment supplies the domain in which agents might imagine their advanced conduct has disappeared.
Presence with witnessing converts what was hidden into a confrontable record.
A delivered report makes the record speak back to the people who produced it.
Purposive action identifies the report's content as authored conduct rather than alien information.
Arrival from a journey lets the advanced deed be imagined as returning evidence rather than lost cargo.
Hands preserve authorship through the outward dispatch and the later report.

structural_cues: 62:7 says the hands sent something ahead; 62:8 returns the people and then informs them of their work.
The knowing formula expands from wrongdoers in the focus to concealed and witnessed domains after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, return, disclosure, concealment, witnessing, report, and authored work; I personify the record as traveling out and speaking back. A live alternative reads the informing as a fresh divine statement with no return itinerary for deeds.

changed_reading.before: Past deeds remain behind while God independently knows them.
changed_reading.after: The deeds travel ahead but return as an authored report: distance cannot sever them from the hands that made them.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the impossible death-wish proof, the context supplies a smaller embodied proof: hear a call, gather, move purposefully toward remembrance, and release an exchange judged beneficial. Truthful orientation is tested by interruptible possession and redirected motion, not by theatrical appetite for extinction alone.

activation_trace.role: The raised call creates an audible claim on the body that can be answered in real time.
A day or summons that gathers people gives the response a collective, observable form.
Purposeful movement toward a sought object supplies the enacted direction absent from mere wishing.
Active recollection gives the movement an orienting object rather than leaving it as bare locomotion.
Letting go supplies a concrete relinquishment that can verify priority through action.
Exchange for price identifies the immediately costly activity that must be interrupted.
Inclination toward practical benefit reframes the release as choosing a better good rather than despising all gain.
Hand-to-hand settlement ties the focus record directly to the exchange that the later command says to release.
Matching act to act lets the later relinquishment function as a practical counterproof to failed speech.

structural_cues: The death-wish challenge demands an extreme verbal performance; 62:9 demands an ordinary, observable interruption of exchange.
The later command coordinates hearing, movement, recollection, release, and valuation in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the call, gathering, directed movement, remembrance, release, exchange, benefit, and act-matching; I infer that 62:9 offers a lower-cost embodied analogue of the earlier truth test. A live alternative keeps the two addressed groups and commands strictly separate while preserving only a formal echo.

changed_reading.before: Truth would be shown by sincerely wanting death.
changed_reading.after: The deeper test is whether desire and possession can be redirected now: releasing a live exchange for remembrance supplies the hand-level proof that the grand death claim lacks.

context_deltas.mechanism: Completion is followed by spreading through the land, seeking bounty, remembering, and enduring success. This weakens any reading in which 62:7 condemns attachment to life or commerce as such: the contextual alternative is rhythmic reorientation within worldly activity, not permanent withdrawal from it.

activation_trace.role: Completion and conclusion give worship a bounded phase rather than making it an endless suspension of work.
Opening out and spreading authorizes renewed movement through ordinary space after gathering.
Purposeful seeking validates desire when its object and limits are rightly ordered.
Bounty as gift makes material pursuit compatible with reception from God rather than inherently suspect.
Continued recollection supplies the regulator that keeps dispersion and seeking aligned.
Success as flourishing and persistence makes ongoing life, not fascination with death, the constructive outcome.
The latent death image is contained by a context that positively commands renewed seeking and flourishing.
Wrong placement, rather than worldly movement itself, becomes the sharpened target of blame.

structural_cues: 62:9 interrupts exchange, but 62:10 immediately restores dispersion and the pursuit of bounty after prayer ends.
Remembrance is carried into renewed seeking rather than replacing it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded completion, spreading, seeking, gift, remembrance, and flourishing; I use them to weaken an ascetic inference from the death challenge. A live alternative retains a stronger contrast between sacred gathering and ordinary pursuit while still denying that work is prohibited.

changed_reading.before: The failure to wish for death shows that continued worldly life and gain are themselves the problem.
changed_reading.after: The problem is misordered claim and conduct, not life or gain: rightly timed dispersion, seeking, remembrance, and flourishing are explicitly restored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final scene shows sight becoming attraction, attraction becoming collective scattering, and scattering leaving a person standing. This turns the focus hand record into a repeated sensorimotor allegiance: what agents notice and value repeatedly directs bodies away, while what is near God and apportioned by God offers a competing center.

activation_trace.role: Visual perception supplies the first link by which an external lure enters action.
Trade as profit-seeking identifies the visible value that captures attention and redirects movement.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the attentional switch behind the departure.
The group's breaking apart makes private valuation visible as collective bodily dispersion.
Departure that leaves an effect behind makes abandonment itself part of the enduring record.
Standing upright supplies the stationary human remainder against the crowd's outward motion.
Nearness and presence establish the alternative value-center located with God.
Apportioned giving counters the anxious idea that visible trade is the only source of provision.
Intending and heading toward something links the later crowd movement back to what hands deliberately send ahead.
The possessing hand connects attention to the goods and control around which allegiance is organized.

structural_cues: 62:11 narrates a rapid chain from seeing to scattering toward a lure and leaving someone standing.
Its closing comparison relocates value from visible trade to what is present with God and then names provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, profit-seeking, distraction, scattering, abandonment, standing, nearness, provision, and directed intention; I infer a recurrent attention-to-action circuit as part of the hand record. A live alternative confines the final scene to its own audience and treats its relation to 62:7 as analogy rather than shared diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: What the hands advanced is a closed archive of isolated past acts.
changed_reading.after: It is also a directional habit: perception and valuation repeatedly recruit the body toward visible gain, leaving traces of what and whom it abandons.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a temporal adverb's wild-aversion branch color, but not replace, its normal durative force. It remains anchored in the focus duration root and is independently activated by explicit flight and later scattering; downstream prose should present it as an affective-kinetic undertone, not as the lexical translation of never.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The permanent refusal is causally tied to the hand record, while the next ayah turns refusal into flight.

activation_trace.role: Wild aversion and bolting lend the durative refusal a recurring bodily recoil.
Explicit escape activates the otherwise remote aversion image inside the focus duration.
Collective scattering shows the same recoil pattern in a different attraction-and-departure scene.

changed_reading.before: Never marks only how long the refusal lasts.
changed_reading.after: Never may also carry the feel of repeated bolting: an enduring recoil whose direction changes but whose avoidance persists.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it activates the wishing root's camel-pregnancy testing interval. It remains worth carrying because the focus names an unperformed wish, grounds it in prior bodily evidence, and is followed by concealed-versus-witnessed knowledge; downstream prose should label it a diagnostic analogy, never a direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-wish functions as evidence of a condition already established by the hands and known to God.

activation_trace.role: A waiting interval used to disclose pregnancy supplies a diagnostic model in which time reveals an already hidden condition.
Disclosure by the Knower makes the refusal evidence rather than an opaque private state.
Hiddenness supplies the concealed condition that the test interval is imagined to expose.
Witnessed presence supplies the revealed state at the far side of the diagnostic interval.

changed_reading.before: The lack of wishing is itself the final fact.
changed_reading.after: The lack of wishing can function like a waiting test that makes a prior hidden condition legible: the hands have already determined what the mouth cannot bring forth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the wishing root's generative fluid and wrongdoing's overgrowing tree into social and ecological consequence. It remains anchored in what hands send ahead and is activated by later growth catching up and spreading; downstream prose should describe consequences as seed-like, not claim biological etymology for the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: What the hands advance can be read as something generative whose effects exceed the originating actor.

activation_trace.role: Generative fluid from which a form is determined supplies the seed image for consequences sent forward.
Forward dispatch places that generative consequence in a later field.
A tree whose shoots exceed its base supplies the image of effects outgrowing their point of origin.
A later plant or fruit following the first activates delayed growth that catches up after an initial act.
Opening, branching, and spreading give the delayed consequence a mode of propagation.

changed_reading.before: Each deed is a fixed item awaiting its individual author.
changed_reading.after: A deed may be seed-like: sent ahead, it branches beyond its origin and later effects catch up through a wider field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the duration root's emptied-dwelling branch through the later abandonment scene. It remains anchored in the focus adverb and in the repeated contrast between departure and standing; downstream prose should present the empty station as a spatial echo of failed commitment, not redefine the adverb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Permanent non-wishing leaves the claimed position uninhabited while deeds alone have departed ahead.

activation_trace.role: An emptied, deserted dwelling spatializes never as a claim-position from which its occupants are absent.
The deeds' departure ahead leaves the makers behind in the vacated claim-space.
Leaving while an effect remains activates abandonment as a durable trace.
The one left standing supplies the occupied point against which the surrounding social vacancy becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Never is an indefinitely repeated negative response.
changed_reading.after: Never may also image a deserted station: the claimed closeness has no one standing in it when an embodied response is demanded.

strongest_changes: The death-wish becomes a costly claim-action proof whose result is supplied by the hands, not a generic statement about fear.
The carrying parable relocates the problem inside a body-map: revealed knowledge remained an external load instead of becoming hand-shaped conduct.
The sequence of deeds advancing, death meeting, people returning, and work being reported turns the focus into a reversible itinerary of authored evidence.
The gather-release-disperse sequence corrects an ascetic reading: ordinary seeking is restored, but attention, possession, and movement must remain reorientable.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots generated unusually coherent cross-domain mechanisms: wishing could be desire, calibration, recitation, fabrication, or diagnostic interval; hands could be acts, gifts, power, possession, and exchange; and permanence could become stasis, recoil, or an emptied station. Context did not collapse these into one meaning but selectively activated several coexisting readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The recitation and hidden-state readings of the wishing root are deliberately form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The transfer from the group challenged in 62:6-8 to the embodied practices commanded in 62:9-11 may be analogical rather than a single-subject diagnosis.
The directional race and returning-record models infer causal geometry from sequence; the same cues can remain separate rhetorical movements.
The gift-liability reading depends on treating received bounty as entrusted capacity, an arrow supplied by the reader rather than stated by the packet.
